spans.s:
स्नेहः [स्निह्-घञ्]
1 Affection,
love, kindness, tenderness;
स्नेहदाक्षिण्ययोर्योगात् कामीव प्रतिभाति मे

(where it has sense 6 also);
अस्ति मे सोदरस्नेहोप्येतेषु Ś. 1.
--2
Oiliness, viscidity, unctuousness,
lubricity (one of the 24 Guṇas
according to the Vaiśeṣikas).
--3 Moisture.
--4 Grease, fat, any unctuous
substance.
--5 Oil; निर्विष्टविषयस्नेहः स
दशांतमुपेयिवान्

.
--6 Any fluid of
the body, such as semen.
--Comp.
--अक्त a. oiled, lubricated, greased
--अनुवृत्तिः f. affectionate or
friendly intercourse.
--आशः a lamp.
--छेदः, --भंगः breach or loss of
friendship.
--पूर्वं ind.
[]
affectionately.
--प्रवृत्तिः f. flow or course of
love; Ś. 4. 16.
--प्रिय a. fond of
oil.
--(यः) a lamp.
--बीजः the
Piyāla tree.
--भूः phlegm.
--भूमिः
f. {1} anything yielding oil. {2}
an object of love or affection,
beloved person.
--रंगः sesamum^1.
--वस्तिः f. injection of oil, an oily
enema.
--विमर्दित a. anointed with
oil.
--व्यक्तिः f. manifestation of
love, display of friendship; (भवति)
स्नेहव्यक्तिश्चिरविरहजं मुंचतो बाष्पमुष्णं

.
--संभाषः kind
conversation, friendly talk, chat.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210122. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48.

स्नेहन् m.
1 A friend.
--2 The moon.
--3 A kind of disease.

स्नेहन a. [स्निह्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
1
Anointing, lubricating.
--2 Destroying.
--नं
1 Anointing, unction, rubbing
or smearing with oil or unguents.
--2 Unctuousness.
--3 An unguent,
emollient.

स्नेहित p. p.
1 Loved.
--2 Kind,
affectionate.
--3 Anointed,
lubricated.
--तः A friend, a beloved
person.

स्नेहिन् a. (नी f.) [स्नेह-णिनि]
1
Attached, affectionate, friendly.
--2
Oily, unctuous, fat. --m.
1 A
friend.
--2 An anointer, a smearer.
--3 A painter.

1 The moon.
--2 A kind
of disease.
